title: Grow Your Bitcoin with Mirror Trading International
description: Grow Your Bitcoin with Mirror Trading International (MTI). Get your software and other bonuses now: ...

asr.full_text: Objective of mirror trading international is to grow your Bitcoin. Your balance in trade is always in Bitcoin, and you earn Bitcoin daily. When the price of Bitcoin rises the value of your trading account will go up. mirror trading international has a sustainable business model trading forex using advanced intelligent software with Bitcoin as the base currency. The profitability of mirror trading international comes solely from the trading activities. Your full investment goes into your trading account. Mirror trading international provides you with a passive income opportunity. Earn passively from daily trading which takes place from Monday to Friday. The trade results are not guaranteed. No trading knowledge is required. To get started you will need a bitcoin wallet to register with Mirotrading international and $100 in bitcoin, which is the suggested minimum. You will need to fund your account within seven days. Accounts not funded will be deleted from the system after seven days. In Mirotrading International there are No membership fees No subscriptions, No packages, No costs, No deductions Your full Bitcoin payment goes to your Trading account There are no contracts or Lockdowns You can withdraw in Full or partial amounts And you can withdraw whenever you like There are no withdrawal fees or penalties. Withdrawal requests will be sent your bitcoin wallet within 48 hours, as long as it's not over a weekend because then it might take a bit longer. Profits from successful daily trades are divided and allocated as follows. 40 percent to you, the member, 30% to the trading system, 10% to Mirror Trading International for administration and to pay the referral bonuses, and 20% to the binary profit-sharing bonuses. All income is subject to positive daily trading results. The system is fully automated and you can sit back and relax and receive your daily statements detailing the income from the trades for the day. Your daily trade income is automatically compounded. Members are not permitted their own broker accounts as per the terms of the Software Licence Agreement. Your account remains active provided you maintain a minimum balance in trade. The suggested amount is $100 in Bitcoin. Providing you with a passive, sustainable income from your Bitcoin in trade is at the very heart of Mirror Trading International. That summarizes the passive part of the opportunity, and as a member you will earn from the daily trading activities and will grow your Bitcoin. Mirror Trading International has an optional affiliate program should you wish to refer your friends or new members.

textual.observation: The source promotes a Bitcoin trading opportunity that asks viewers to register with a Bitcoin wallet and provide a suggested $100 Bitcoin deposit in connection with claims of daily passive Bitcoin income.

evidence.quote: To get started you will need a bitcoin wallet to register with Mirotrading international and $100 in bitcoin, which is the suggested minimum.
Providing you with a passive, sustainable income from your Bitcoin in trade is at the very heart of Mirror Trading International.

textual.context: Promotional presentation in the title, description and ASR; the source also states that trading results are not guaranteed and describes conditions for funding and account activity.
textual.potential_relevance: The combination of a requested Bitcoin payment and wallet registration with claims of daily or passive income creates a reward-and-payment relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish whether the trading activity, income claims, company, wallet process or any transaction outcome is genuine or verified.

textual.observation: The source describes an optional affiliate program in which members may refer friends or new members, alongside an allocation of profits that includes referral bonuses.

evidence.quote: 10% to Mirror Trading International for administration and to pay the referral bonuses, and 20% to the binary profit-sharing bonuses.
Mirror Trading International has an optional affiliate program should you wish to refer your friends or new members.

textual.context: The referral activity is described as optional and is presented as part of the promotional opportunity; the records do not show whether any referral payment was actually made.
textual.potential_relevance: A stated opportunity to refer friends or new members is linked to a profit-allocation structure that mentions referral bonuses, creating a recruitment-and-reward relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not specify the eligibility rules, exact referral compensation, number of required recruits, or actual financial results.

visual.potential_relevance: A claimed recurring income or return is linked to placing Bitcoin into the promoted trading activity.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish that the stated income was achieved by viewers or that future returns would match the displayed figures.

visual.limitations: The frames do not show an actual payment, withdrawal request, wallet transfer, or completed withdrawal.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes a Bitcoin trading opportunity that asks viewers to register a wallet, provide $100 in Bitcoin, and fund the account within seven days in exchange for claimed daily or passive income. It describes the payment flow, withdrawals into a Bitcoin wallet, and optional referral bonuses. The results are qualified as non-guaranteed and historical, but the video still solicits Bitcoin participation for claimed income.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The promoted software-based forex trading arrangement links funding a Bitcoin trading account to claimed passive, automatically compounded trading income. The speaker qualifies the results as non-guaranteed and dependent on positive trading days.
